chunks: As for what al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from al-Naḍr, from Muḥammad ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Yaʿqūb ibn Shuʿayb, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the taslīm in the two rakʿahs of al-watr. He said: If you wish, you may say the taslīm; and if you wish, you may refrain from saying the taslīm.

key_terms.التَّسْلِيمِ: the salutation marking the conclusion of salat (prayer)
key_terms.الْوَتْرِ: the witr prayer referred to in this narration
key_terms.تُسَلِّمْ: you do not perform the taslīm

ai.seo_question: Is taslīm obligatory in the two rakʿahs before witr prayer according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling of giving taslīm in the two rakʿahs associated with the witr prayer. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that it is optional, indicating permissibility in either performing or omitting the taslīm at that point.
